You are reviewing a small uncommitted Go diff in the repo at /Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.entire/worktrees/pfleidi-cor-1430-cli-enable-async-mirror-creation-by-default (run all commands from there; do not cd elsewhere). Angle: EFFICIENCY. Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O, independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to hot paths, long-lived closures capturing large scopes. Name the cheaper alternative. Do not hunt for correctness bugs.

Run `git diff HEAD` to see the diff (files: cmd/entire/cli/repo_mirror.go, cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go, cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings_test.go). The change turns `EntireSettings.AsyncMirrorRequests` from `bool` into `*bool` (nil = true) with a new accessor `IsAsyncMirrorRequestsEnabled()`, removes a `loadFromFileWithDefaults` helper, switches the merge to `mergeRawBoolPtr`, and adds a table test that loads, saves, and re-reads a settings file. Read the surrounding code as needed. Note: settings.Load is uncached and runs several times per git hook, so anything on the load path matters; the mirror create command path is user-invoked and not hot.

Report findings as: file, line, one-line summary, concrete cost, cheaper alternative. If nothing to flag, say so plainly — a small diff with no efficiency issues is a valid result.

## Efficiency review — nothing serious; one test-cost item

### Flagged

**`/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.entire/worktrees/pfleidi-cor-1430-cli-enable-async-mirror-creation-by-default/cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings_test.go:669-712` — `TestSave_PreservesAsyncMirrorRequestsPresence` drives a full repo + filesystem round trip to test a pure marshaling property.**

Cost, per subtest (3 of them): `setupSettingsDir` does `t.TempDir` + `MkdirAll` + `testutil.InitRepo` (go-git `PlainInit` plus a config read/write) + `t.Chdir`. The `t.Chdir` also invalidates the process-wide worktree-root cache in `cmd/entire/cli/paths/paths.go:80-104` (keyed on cwd), so each subtest forces a fresh `resolveWorktreeRoot` — a git resolution that `LoadFromFile` and `Save`→`entiredir.PathTo`→`anchor` both hit. Then a settings write, an atomic save, an `os.ReadFile`, and two `json.Unmarshal` passes. That is roughly 3 repo inits and ~9 filesystem operations to assert that a `*bool` field marshals as absent / `true` / `false`.

Cheaper alternative: assert directly on `jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(&EntireSettings{Enabled: true, AsyncMirrorRequests: nil | ptr(true) | ptr(false)}, "", "  ")` — same three cases, zero I/O, zero git, no `t.Chdir` cache thrash, and the subtests could then run in parallel. If the load leg is genuinely part of the property being tested, `loadFromFile` on a `t.TempDir` file plus an in-memory marshal still avoids `InitRepo` and `Save`'s anchor resolution entirely.

### Checked and clean (no action)

- `cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go:1027-1030` — removing `loadFromFileWithDefaults` is a net **win** on the hot load path: the old helper took `defaults EntireSettings` **by value** and then took its address (`settings := &defaults`), so every `loadFromFile` call copied the whole ~66-field struct into an escaping parameter. The composite literal now allocates once. Since `settings.Load` is uncached and runs several times per git hook, that copy is gone from each of those calls.
- `cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go:1300` — `mergeRawBoolPtr` adds one heap-allocated `bool` per layer that actually sets `async_mirror_requests`. That is 1 byte and only when the key is present; identical to the existing `telemetry` / `sign_checkpoint_commits` handling. Not worth changing.
- `cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go:1935-1937` — `IsAsyncMirrorRequestsEnabled` is a nil check plus a deref, trivially inlinable; no recomputation, no I/O.
- `cmd/entire/cli/repo_mirror.go:498` — field read becomes an inlined method call on an already-loaded struct, on a user-invoked path. Free.

No new sequential-but-independent I/O, no blocking work added to the load path, no long-lived closures introduced.
